scenes.title: 开学第一天
scenes.subtitle: A new school day
scenes.story: A new school day begins. A girl smiles at Mia. Her classmate waves, and everyone says good morning. They talk about life at school.
scenes.storyZh: 新的上学日开始了。一个女孩向米娅微笑。她的同班同学挥挥手，每个人都说早上好。他们谈论学校生活。

scenes.title: 上午的课程
scenes.subtitle: Lessons in the classroom
scenes.story: The first subject is English. The next subject is Chinese. In maths, the class counts apples. Mia says that every subject is interesting.
scenes.storyZh: 第一门科目是英语。下一门科目是汉语。数学课上，大家数苹果。米娅说每个科目都很有趣。

scenes.title: 电脑教室
scenes.subtitle: Science and computers
scenes.story: Today the class goes to the computer room. They study science with a short video. In IT, Mia makes a poster. Tom also makes one.
scenes.storyZh: 今天全班去电脑教室。他们通过短视频学习科学。信息科技课上，米娅制作了一张海报。汤姆也制作了一张。

scenes.title: 故事时间
scenes.subtitle: A story after class
scenes.story: After class, Mia uses a computer to find a story. The story is about a clever bird. She reads it to the class.
scenes.storyZh: 下课后，米娅用计算机找故事。故事讲的是一只聪明的鸟。她读给全班听。

scenes.title: 周一到周三
scenes.subtitle: The first school days
scenes.story: A busy week begins on Monday. Mia reads a book on Tuesday. On Wednesday, she brings it back to the library.
scenes.storyZh: 忙碌的一周从星期一开始。米娅在星期二读了一本书。星期三，她把书还回图书馆。

scenes.title: 周四到周日
scenes.subtitle: From school to the weekend
scenes.story: Thursday is quiet after school. Friday brings the art show. On Saturday, Mia visits a museum. Sunday is a day for family.
scenes.storyZh: 星期四放学后很安静。星期五迎来了美术展。星期六，米娅参观博物馆。星期日是陪伴家人的一天。

scenes.title: 兴趣课
scenes.subtitle: Music and dance
scenes.story: At the music club, children dance to a happy song. Mia has a piano lesson next. She plays one tune for the club.
scenes.storyZh: 在音乐俱乐部，孩子们随着欢快的歌曲跳舞。米娅接下来有一节钢琴课。她为俱乐部弹了一首曲子。

scenes.title: 周末探望
scenes.subtitle: A family visit
scenes.story: Mia goes with her parents to visit her grandparent. They cook, talk and take a walk together.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅和父母一起去看望祖辈。他们一起做饭、聊天和散步。

scenes.title: 四季的变化
scenes.subtitle: A colourful year
scenes.story: Each season brings a colourful change. Spring is fresh, summer is bright and autumn is golden. Winter turns the town white.
scenes.storyZh: 每个季节都带来五彩缤纷的变化。春天清新，夏天明亮，秋天金黄。冬天把小镇变成白色。

scenes.title: 花园与山坡
scenes.subtitle: Plants around us
scenes.story: We plant seeds beside the old tree. A flower opens near the gate, and sheep walk up the green hill.
scenes.storyZh: 我们在老树旁种下种子。门边开出一朵花，羊群走上绿色的小山。

scenes.title: 天气的感觉
scenes.subtitle: Warm and cold days
scenes.story: The morning air is cool. By noon, the sun is hot. The room stays warm in the afternoon. At night it is cold, and snow begins to fall.
scenes.storyZh: 清晨的空气很凉爽。到了中午，太阳很热。下午房间仍然温暖。夜里很冷，开始下雪。

scenes.title: 户外活动
scenes.subtitle: Fun on the hill
scenes.story: A clever child makes a kite and watches it fly. In summer we swim; in winter we ski and climb the snowy hill.
scenes.storyZh: 一个聪明的孩子做了一只风筝，看着它飞翔。夏天我们游泳，冬天我们滑雪并爬上雪山。

scenes.title: 天气播报
scenes.subtitle: Checking the sky
scenes.story: The morning is sunny, but the sky soon becomes cloudy. The weather report says it will be windy. Mia watches the report before school.
scenes.storyZh: 早晨天气晴朗，但天空很快变得多云。天气预报说今天会多风。米娅上学前看了天气播报。

scenes.title: 出门准备
scenes.subtitle: Dressing for the day
scenes.story: On a snowy day, Mia will put on a thick coat. It is foggy, so the bus driver can't go fast. On a rainy day, she stays inside.
scenes.storyZh: 下雪天，米娅穿上厚外套。天气有雾，所以公交车不能开快。下雨天，她留在室内。

scenes.title: 雨天球馆
scenes.subtitle: Games after the rain
scenes.story: Rain falls in the afternoon. All the students wait in the gym. They play ping-pong, and everyone is all right.
scenes.storyZh: 下午下雨了。所有学生都在体育馆等待。他们打乒乓球，每个人都安然无恙。

scenes.title: 旅行叮嘱
scenes.subtitle: A trip to Lhasa
scenes.story: Mia is sorry that she cannot go to Lhasa today. Grandpa tells her to take a map and care for her ticket. She says she will take care on the train.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅很抱歉今天不能去拉萨。爷爷让她带上地图，并保管好车票。她说会在火车上保重。

scenes.title: 不同爱好
scenes.subtitle: Everyone has a favourite
scenes.story: Every child has a different hobby. Mia likes to run. Ben plays basketball, and Lily can skip all afternoon.
scenes.storyZh: 每个孩子都有不同的业余爱好。米娅喜欢跑步。本打篮球，莉莉能跳一下午绳。

scenes.title: 才艺表演
scenes.subtitle: Getting ready for the show
scenes.story: Mia decides to join the class show. Everyone must get ready after lunch. They practise well, then enjoy a small party.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅决定参加班级演出。午饭后每个人都必须准备好。他们认真练习，然后享受一场小派对。

scenes.title: 音乐与剪纸
scenes.subtitle: Art in many forms
scenes.story: A dancer moves to the beat of a drum. An artist makes a paper-cut of a red flower. Paper-cutting is a traditional art.
scenes.storyZh: 一位舞者随着鼓点舞动。一位艺术家剪出一朵红花。剪纸是一种传统艺术。

scenes.title: 家人来访
scenes.subtitle: A family afternoon
scenes.story: Mia's uncle brings fruit, and her aunt brings a cake. They stay for tea and talk about their hobbies.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅的叔叔带来了水果，阿姨带来了蛋糕。他们留下来喝茶，并谈论各自的爱好。

scenes.title: 俱乐部成员
scenes.subtitle: Meeting the club
scenes.story: A new member has a red bag and long hair. Her bag is over there, beside the door. We cheer for her, and Mia shows him where to sit.
scenes.storyZh: 一位新成员有红色书包和长发。她的书包在那边，就在门旁。我们为她加油，米娅告诉他坐哪里。

scenes.title: 美术作品
scenes.subtitle: Choosing a picture
scenes.story: The artist will show which painting is new. Mia will wear a blue shirt and paint a flower. Her work hangs by the window.
scenes.storyZh: 艺术家将展示哪幅画是新的。米娅会穿蓝色衬衫并画一朵花。她的作品挂在窗边。

scenes.title: 城市工作者
scenes.subtitle: People who help us
scenes.story: A businessman opens the shop. A farmer brings vegetables to the hospital. A tall man asks a policeman for help, and the police show him the way.
scenes.storyZh: 一位商人打开商店。一位农民把蔬菜送到医院。一位高个子男人向警察求助，警察给他指路。

scenes.title: 社区散步
scenes.subtitle: Around the neighbourhood
scenes.story: Grandpa walks past the station and the police station. He meets a gardener near the hotel. A woman waves to them from the park.

scenes.title: 友好沟通
scenes.subtitle: Clear and kind words
scenes.story: Mia thinks of a kind way to welcome the visitors. Good communication starts with listening. The visitors may ask questions, and the students speak slowly.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅想用一种友好的方式欢迎来访者。良好的沟通从倾听开始。来访者可以提问，学生们慢慢地说。

scenes.title: 邀请活动
scenes.subtitle: Planning a meeting
scenes.story: The club will hold a party this year. Mia invites three new members and gives each one an invitation. Please hold on while she finds one more.
scenes.storyZh: 俱乐部今年将举行派对。米娅邀请三位新成员，并给每人一张邀请函。她再找一张时，请大家稍等。

scenes.title: 准备信件
scenes.subtitle: Cards and emails
scenes.story: Mia has an idea for the class card. She will write a note and send an email. Everyone must get ready before the teacher arrives.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅对班级卡片有了一个主意。她要写一段话并发一封电子邮件。老师来之前，每个人都必须准备好。

scenes.title: 周末联系
scenes.subtitle: Calls and weekend fun
scenes.story: On Saturday, Mia will send a letter and call her cousin. The family meets online before the horse racing begins. A white horse races past. Later they watch crosstalk, and Mia is sure everyone had fun.
scenes.storyZh: 星期六，米娅会寄一封信并给表姐打电话。赛马开始前，家人在线相聚。一匹白马跑过。后来他们观看相声，米娅确信每个人都玩得很开心。
